hardware_lock: single Kaggle T4 for all main numbers; do not mix GPU types

upstream.note: Post-submission release for v3. Mixed GPU types moved accuracy at the scale of their measured effects (README update notes).

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
model.revision_policy: frozen from extra development run (model.config._commit_hash on Kaggle T4); use this sha for Stage C

precision.inference: float16 on T4 (sm < 8.0); bfloat16 only if a later replication uses Ampere+
precision.alignment: float32 (released ModelWrapper already builds the realignment matrix and applies it in float32)
precision.compression: float32 for OBF QR/SVD/Gram and residual injection (released HOBF/HOBFFast already cast values to float32, then write back in the cache dtype)
precision.do_not: cast the whole process, including alignment and OBF, to float16

decoding.inventory: greedy one-line answers, max_new_tokens 48; document difference from the paper's T=0.6, top_p=0.95 sampling

stage_a.purpose: confirm the pipeline executes, including alignment-matrix construction and OBF; not a reproduction of paper accuracy

sensitivity.note: held-out no-filler check because development filler changed the eviction penalty and the OBF gap

main_comparison.h3: skipped; no reservation rule was frozen on development
main_comparison.lead: sender-only accuracy vs actual relay size for eviction and OBF; shared panel is interpretive

evidence_selection_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic intervention on development examples. Force the complete relevant inventory line inside the existing 32-slot budget, then fill remaining slots with the original attention rule. Unrelated-line control reserves the same number of slots. Not a proposed compressor. Leave OBF unchanged. Do not generate a new held-out set until this is interpreted.

practical_selection.question: Can we automatically obtain the accuracy recovery demonstrated by evidence-preserving selection, at the same relay budget and with little additional computation?
practical_selection.probe: one forward pass of B's question and choices on A's full cache; discard new KV; rank original prompt positions. Simulated at the sender. Extra time is compute, not communication.
practical_selection.question_match: parse the package name from the question and keep that complete inventory line. Does not use the gold locker or record index. This format makes exact-name matching unusually easy.
practical_selection.oracle: known relevant line on the same cache; ceiling, not a method

fresh_validation.question: Does the development recovery generalize to fresh examples, and does it depend on probing the correct package rather than a generic or recency effect?
fresh_validation.claim: On 20 development examples, question-informed selectors recovered full-relay-level accuracy at roughly one-fifth of the relay size, without using answer labels. We will investigate when this recovery generalizes and which cached representations make it possible.

question_withheld.question_match: parse the package from B's question and keep that complete inventory line; no gold locker or record index
question_withheld.scoring: shared extractor is primary for every method; correct_legacy keeps the original first-match rule
question_withheld.question: In the withheld-question setting, does simple record matching recover accuracy as cheaply as the correct-question probe?

text_baseline.message: UTF-8 bytes of the matched fact sentence, e.g. Package Luma is in locker 7.
text_baseline.compare_from: existing results_stage_practical on the same 20 development examples
text_baseline.note: Development check, not new held-out evidence. Tests whether B needs the latent KV message for this one-record lookup.

hop_two_record.question: On a two-record lookup, does question-probed KV beat practical text (iterative retrieval or sender-generated summary)?

dependencies_critical.reason: upstream KV relay uses DynamicCache key_cache/value_cache; transformers 4.58+ breaks it
